title: Kopitiam Keycap Clicker
description: Press a red-dot pau or a green-striped kopi cup. Both caps fit the same jade saucer keychain, inspired by a Singapore kopitiam breakfast.
printNote: Add one full-height MX-style clicky switch and a metal split ring. Print the base and your choice of cap at 100% scale. Clip the switch into the square opening, press the cap onto its stem, then attach the ring. Switch fit and keyring strength need a test print.
dimensions: 40.4 × 36 mm base · approx. 34 mm tall with pau
